summary: An administrator can list a repository's orphaned recovery points (VM not in the pool master's VM inventory) and delete chosen VMs' points from the destination and catalog; Core plans, deletes and records per-point results.

guide.reason: Operators get the Orphaned backups workflow: what counts as an orphan, protected and in-use handling, typed confirmation, results and recovery.

api.reason: New Controller routes GET .../backup-repositories/{repo_id}/orphans, POST .../orphan-cleanups and GET .../orphan-cleanups/{request_id}; Core command backup-orphan-cleanup; channel query GET /backup-orphans; Core-local routes for the same three. Administrator session, Origin and CSRF on the POST; the command is validated and receipted on the master, so a request_id replays its recorded outcome and a changed payload is 409.

roadmap.reason: Completes repository space management inside the current backup slice; no milestone or acceptance gate changes.

state.record: pool-backup-orphan-cleanups/<request_id>.json (plan and per-point results) beside pool-backup-catalog/ on the pool master, plus the existing metadata receipt; the orphan set is derived on the master from pool-vms.json and the catalog, and the deletion goes through the existing retention delete.
state.reason: Core decides what is an orphan from its own durable VM inventory and records the plan and outcomes; Controller keeps only the operation row and relays the master's query and record, so a fresh Controller shows the same list and results. Limitation: the cleanup record is not among the records copied to a promoted master; the receipt is, and a repeat there re-plans against current counts.

verification.method: Focused Go tests in internal/agent (real master and member from the transfer lab, real filesystem backend with published points) covering grouping and sizes, a VM on an unreachable member not being an orphan, a missing inventory refusing, a member refusing the query, wrong confirmation and count mismatch refusals, a still-present VM refusing, deletion of selected groups with destination data removed, protected skipped by default and deleted with include_protected, pinned points always skipped, replay and changed-payload conflict, interrupted-run resume from the plan, a re-created VM skipped, and other VMs' points untouched; making every point an orphan made the test fail. Controller route test for CSRF, authentication, validation, queueing, replay and conflict; local route test. Web unit test, tsc and npm test. No browser walkthrough, real NFS/SMB/S3/SFTP destination, promoted-master run or multi-host lab was run.
